paragraphs: [ir hand y ts all In equity,
Villain checks. Hero bets $30. Villain raises to $90. Hero calls.

Hero c-bet with a straight draw and nut flush draw and got checkraised. His hand doesn’t have enough equity to profitably get stacks in against J-10, 10-6s, and 6-5s. He's getting 2-to-1 odds and it’s 4-to-1 against him improving on the turn. The good news is that Villain will usually check-call at least one bet with a set or a straight when a flush completes on the turn. Villain will also get stacks in if he ever check-raises hearts and ets there. Hero should call and reevaluate on the turn.
